cards.text: The angel Gabriel just told Mary of Nazareth that she'll give birth to a son named Jesus, and that her relative Elizabeth has conceived a son in her old age (Luke 1:26-36). In those days, Mary gets ready and HURRIES to a town in the hill country of Judah. Hurrying into HILL COUNTRY, friend, and I get winded hopping my gold base from one oven to the next.

cards.question: Mary arrives in the hill country of Judah and walks into the home of ___.

cards.text: That's Zechariah, Elizabeth's husband and a priest (Luke 1:5). Mary greets Elizabeth, and the moment Elizabeth hears it, something happens.

cards.question: Mary's greeting reaches Elizabeth's ears. What happens inside Elizabeth?

answers.text: Her baby leaps in her womb

cards.text: Elizabeth is filled with the Holy Spirit and exclaims in a LOUD voice. No indoor voice here, friend, and honestly, same for me every single time my oven timer goes off.

cards.question: Elizabeth tells Mary she's blessed among women. True or false: in the same breath, Elizabeth calls Mary's baby blessed too.
Then Elizabeth asks why she's so honored to have this visitor. What does she call Mary?

answers.text: A prophet of the Most High

cards.question: Elizabeth explains what happened when Mary's greeting reached her ears. She says her baby's leap was a leap of ___.
Elizabeth finishes by calling Mary blessed one more time. What does she say Mary is blessed for?

answers.text: Believing the Lord's word to her will be fulfilled
Traveling all the way to the hill country
Coming from the royal house of David

cards.text: Then Mary says, "My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!" Her soul AND her spirit, friend, the WHOLE Mary is in on this.

cards.question: Mary gives the reason she's rejoicing. What does she say God has looked on with favor?

answers.text: The humble state of His servant
The long prayers of His servant
The good works of His servant

cards.question: True or false: Mary says only the people of her own town will ever call her blessed.
Mary says great things have been done for her. Who does she say did them?

cards.text: And she adds, "Holy is His name." Then Mary moves from what God did for her to how He treats those who fear Him.

cards.question: Mary says God's mercy reaches those who fear Him. How long does she say it lasts?

cards.text: Mary says God has done mighty deeds with His arm and scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.

cards.question: Mary says God has brought rulers down from their thrones and has ___ the humble.
Mary says God has filled the hungry with good things. True or false: she says He has sent the rich away empty.

cards.text: Then Mary says God has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful.

cards.question: Mary says God remembered to be merciful to Israel, just as He had ___ their fathers.

cards.text: She names who that promise was made to: Abraham, Israel's forefather, and his descendants forever.
Mary stays with Elizabeth for about three months and then heads back home. We'll set this batch on the cooling rack for now, friend, but this story is just getting warmed up.
